name: Look Ahead: Circuitos'26
description: Mark your calendars for next weekend, when over 60 art venues across Porto open their doors for a three-day celebration of the city's dynamic art scene.
longDescription:
Circuitos'26 is a city-wide art event taking place over three days, from July 17th to July 19th, 2026. This initiative brings together over 60 art venues across Porto, including galleries, museums, and independent art spaces. The event aims to showcase the breadth and diversity of contemporary art practices within the city, providing a platform for both established and emerging artists. It serves as an opportunity for the public to engage directly with Porto's artistic community and its various institutions.

Visitors to Circuitos'26 can expect a varied experience, moving between different exhibition formats and artistic disciplines. The event is designed for art enthusiasts, local residents, and visitors interested in the cultural offerings of Porto. Each participating venue will present its own programming, ranging from solo exhibitions to group shows and installations. The atmosphere is generally open and accessible, encouraging exploration of the city's artistic landscape.

The majority of events and exhibitions during Circuitos'26 are free to attend, with no prior booking required for most venues. Specific details regarding any ticketed events will be available closer to the date. Given the city-wide nature of the event, venues are distributed across Porto, accessible via the metro, bus network, and on foot. Information on individual venue accessibility will be provided by the participating spaces.
